description: Ten preserved historical gap candidates with dated reconciliation. G5 duplicates FKA-048; not ten verified unique additions. Original metadata and claims are preserved for audit, not endorsed.

records.title: How to Change Your Mind — Chapter 1: "LSD"
records.host: Dir. Lucy Walker; Michael Pollan host
records.legacy_verification_claim: Netflix global release, dubbed into 10 languages. Fadiman credited as "Self — Psychologist" on IMDb. He describes the 1966 creativity study: "we had 48 problems and 48 satisfactory solutions." Almost certainly his highest-viewership appearance. Confirmed via IMDb full cast listing.

reconciliation.method: Primary publisher/organizer/official-archive inspection; availability limits recorded
reconciliation.finding: Netflix title URL could not be retrieved. Search found IMDb credit, but no accessible primary episode credits were inspected in this pass. Highest-viewership and ten-language assertions remain unsupported.

records.title: Inside LSD — National Geographic documentary
records.legacy_verification_claim: National Geographic television documentary. Fadiman appears discussing 1960s problem-solving research. Only known pre-2011 mainstream television appearance — predates the archive's systematic coverage. Referenced in Fadiman's own materials. Not on archive.

reconciliation.method: Primary publisher/organizer/official-archive inspection; availability limits recorded
reconciliation.finding: Official archive HTML contains a commented-out 2009 National Geographic documentary listing with Fadiman appearance intervals and two obsolete YouTube embeds. This supports an historical lead, not playable media. No accessible current National Geographic episode page was found in the targeted search. Legacy only-known-pre2011-mainstream-appearance claim is unsupported and conflicts with 1968 KQED catalogue entry.
